title: GallosOS Contest Directives
description: Schema for GallosOS gallos.toml directives file. Validates global settings, execution mode configurations (Contest > Event > Default), branding, software modules, and scheduling.

website_list.description: Array of allowed domain names. Use ['*'] to allow all traffic.

items.description: Software module identifier. Format: '<category>/<package>'. The 'drivers' category is for opt-in hardware drivers not baked into the base image by default (e.g. 'drivers/nvidia-proprietary') — see docs/HARDWARE_COMPATIBILITY.md § 1.3.

software_list.description: List of SquashFS software modules to enable for this mode.

url.description: Full URL or local file path.

allow_usb_storage.description: Whether to allow USB mass-storage devices to be mounted.

allow_audio.description: Whether audio output is enabled via PipeWire. Defaults to false in Contest mode to preserve arena quietness; enabled in Event and Default modes for lectures and practice tutorials.

wallpaper.description: URL to remote wallpaper image, 'default' for GallosOS stock wallpaper, or local file path.

wallpaper_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex checksum of the remote wallpaper image. Required when 'wallpaper' is a remote URL.

schedule.description: One or more absolute time windows during which this mode is active. Requires NTP-synchronized clock.

duration_minutes.description: Relative contest duration in minutes. Used for air-gapped/Tier 0 deployments where the absolute wall-clock may be unreliable. Timer uses CLOCK_MONOTONIC. When both schedule and duration_minutes are present, absolute schedule takes precedence if the clock is NTP-synced; otherwise falls back to duration_minutes.

auto_start_on_boot.description: If true and duration_minutes is set, the relative timer starts automatically when the desktop session is ready. If false, the organizer must trigger it manually via gallos-ctl.

announcements.description: Broadcast notifications and clarifications published by the contest jury.

audit_config.description: Administrative proctoring, auditing, and forensic logging settings for official contest windows.

enable_screen_capture.description: Enable periodic privileged desktop screenshot captures.

screenshot_interval_secs.description: Interval in seconds between automated screen captures.

enable_code_backup.description: Enable incremental background backups of contestant code.

backup_interval_secs.description: Interval in seconds between automated code snapshots.

enable_fleet_telemetry.description: Export live CPU, RAM, and process metrics via Prometheus exporter.

enable_keystroke_forensics.description: Enable kernel-level hardware keystroke event counters for forensic audit.

id.description: Unique announcement identifier to track contestant acknowledgements.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when this clarification was broadcast.

priority.description: Priority level ('urgent' shows full-screen modal, 'info' shows notification banner).

title.description: Headline or subject of the clarification (e.g. 'Clarification: Problem C').

require_ack.description: Require contestant to click an acknowledgement button.

printing_config.description: CUPS network printing configuration for contest environments.

mode.description: Printing deployment architecture: 'hosted' (Controller runs the CUPS/IPP spooler, targeted via printer_host by default), 'external' (points to venue network CUPS/IPP server), or 'none' (printing disabled).

enable_mdns_discovery.description: Opt-in Avahi/mDNS printer discovery for 'hosted' mode. Off by default: real ICPC World Finals deployments statically configure printer_host instead, since mDNS (UDP 5353) is dropped by the firewall unless explicitly enabled here.

enabled.description: Whether printing is enabled (legacy compatibility flag).

printer_host.description: IP address or hostname of the external CUPS print server (used with mode = 'external').

print_metadata_header.description: Prepend automated metadata header (Team name, PC, room, timestamp) to every print job for contest integrity.

max_pages_per_job.description: Maximum number of pages allowed per print job (anti-spam quota limit).

broadcast_config.description: Real-time signed clarification/announcement broadcast subsystem (gallos-broadcast). Global because the Venue Controller can use it during Event-mode camps as well as Contest windows.

enabled.description: If true, gallos-daemon opens a listener socket for signed gallos-broadcast messages. Leave false when the judge handles clarifications through its own portal (DOMjudge, BOCA, CMS).

broadcast_public_key.description: Ed25519 public verification key (hex) used to authenticate signed gallos-broadcast messages.

browser_policy.description: Fine-grained Chromium/Firefox managed URL policies to lock down paths within allowed domains.

url_blocklist.description: List of URLs or prefixes to block (e.g. 'https://omegaup.com/problem*').

url_allowlist.description: List of URLs or prefixes to explicitly allow, overriding the blocklist.

global.description: Global settings applied regardless of active execution mode.

config_expiration.description: After this datetime, the directives file is considered expired and the system falls back to Default mode.

available_keyboard_layouts.description: List of keyboard layouts available for quick switching in the system tray.

default_keyboard_layout.description: Default XKB keyboard layout applied at boot or on mode change. Must be a value from 'available_keyboard_layouts'.

enable_event_mode.description: If true, the [event] section and event.schedule time windows will be parsed and activated.

enable_contest_mode.description: If true, the [contest] section and contest.schedule time windows will be parsed and activated.

branding.description: White-label branding metadata for the event organizer.

name.description: Full event or contest name displayed in the desktop banner.

logo_url.description: URL or local path to the organizer's desktop logo image (PNG/SVG).

boot_splash_logo_url.description: URL or local path to the organizer's logo for the Plymouth boot splash screen.

show_powered_by_gallos.description: If true, a small 'Powered by GallosOS' watermark is rendered underneath the custom boot splash and desktop branding. Highly recommended to support the open-source project.

recovery.description: Local-only root recovery access (su from the kiosk session). No SSH/network component — see docs/ROOT_ACCESS.md. Only ever read from the local baked-in gallos.toml, never from a remote-fetched one.

root_password_hash.description: A crypt(3)-format password hash for the root account (e.g. generated with `openssl passwd -6`), applied via `chpasswd -e` at every daemon boot/reload. Never put a plaintext password here. Omit this key (or leave it unset) to keep root locked, which is the shipped default.

default.description: Configuration for Default (Always) mode — the fallback when no contest or event window is active.

event.description: Configuration for Event mode (training camps, warm-ups, lecture sessions).

contest.description: Configuration for Contest mode (strict lockdown, judge-only network, Anti-Cheat shield active).

machines.description: Centralized machine/team assignment table. Maps MAC addresses to PC names and team names. Used by the central server to assign identities to booting machines.

mac.description: Network interface MAC address (lowercase, colon-separated). Used as the unique machine identifier.

pc_number.description: Numeric PC index for sorting and display.

room.description: Physical room or lab where this machine is located.

team_name.description: Contest team assigned to this machine.

printing.description: Optional CUPS network printing configuration for contest environments.
